source: Read-only DOM metrics from the existing protected SNAP-3 ON Preview before browser access was denied
condition: Ten warm reloads of the same Preview and month; no Apply or financial write; per-sample financial digests were not retained
historicalAdmissions: Canonical HIT and M7 HIT in all ten captured reads
limitations: P95 is descriptive at n=10, not a reliability certification
No after-correction browser measurements were permitted once automatic review hit its usage limit
No edit-to-FRESH or suggestions timeline was captured
Navigation response duration and server observation are inclusive measurements; do not subtract them to assert network latency
